purpose: Outcome-blind primary-AI drafting of reproducible project operationalizations for H2-approved English literature formula evidence.

scope.allowed_inputs: The exported AI worksheet, its cited frozen English formula evidence, frozen local input schema and snapshots, the exact implementation file, and deterministic edge-case tests.
scope.forbidden_inputs: H1 or H2 operationalization decisions, candidate dimensions, selected features, target counts, prediction outcomes, model performance, Qwen/Ollama, local model output, and external LLM APIs.

rules: Do not alter any protected literature-evidence field or attribute a project rule to a source.

Approve only when formula identity, input columns, project missing rule, zero/empty/coverage behavior, transform and units, implementation, test artifact, and frozen input snapshot are all exact and hashable.
A project operationalization cannot rescue an incomplete, review-only, future-dependent, non-article-level, or non-English literature formula.
Distinguish absent input, mathematically undefined values, observed empty sets, structural non-applicability, and valid zero values.
Use no outcome, label, downstream model result, or desired feature count.
